messages:
Omar: deploy-bot blocked the promote. preflight failed: artifact upload errored with ENOSPC on runner during docker layer push -> corrupt object. tagging @Infra-Chen and @Build-Nina, this is in the 15:00 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote 10123 ABORTED: oci.layer_push.failed (ENOSPC) for layer sha256:ffee0011 on runner-build-9. artifact verifier flagged mismatch after partial upload.

Build-Nina: seeing the error on build-9: docker daemon returned: write /var/lib/docker/overlay2/xyz/diff: no space left on device. The uploader retried but manifest now points to partial blob.

Infra-Chen: fs usage on build-9: /var/lib/docker at 98%. There was a gc job scheduled but it overlapped with heavy CI run and didn't free space in time.

QA-Raj: If we re-run CI on a different runner it'll likely succeed. Alternatives: 1) re-run on fresh runner, 2) pin to last-good image that passed preflight, 3) trigger manual GC on build-9 and reupload (risky during change window). Product wants the patch but not at the cost of risking corrupt artifacts.

Janet: PM says prefer re-run on fresh runner if fast. How long to spin a new runner?

Infra-Chen: Spinning a warm runner takes ~90s; copying cached layers might add 2-3 minutes. Given smoke ~3-5m, total fits change window. I can spin a new runner and drain build-9 from CI.

Build-Nina: I'll requeue the build to use runner-build-14 which is idle and has a clean overlay. Also will add a guard to fail early if overlay fs free < 5%.

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual rerun requested by Build-Nina. Job queued on runner-build-14.

Omar: snippet from failing logs for context:
```
2026-03-25T15:02:11Z dockerd: commit layer sha256:ffee0011 -> writing diff
2026-03-25T15:02:11Z dockerd: write /var/lib/docker/overlay2/xyz/diff: no space left on device
2026-03-25T15:02:12Z uploader: retry attempt 1 -> partial blob present
2026-03-25T15:02:43Z verifier: expected sha256=ffee0011 computed=ffefxxxx -> mismatch
2026-03-25T15:02:43Z orchestrator: abort promote, quarantine blob
```

QA-Raj: After rerun please verify manifest digest and run full smoke; partial blobs can linger in the registry if multipart wasn't completed.

Infra-Chen: I cleared space on build-9 (killed orphaned containers, ran docker system prune) and marked it as drained. GC logs saved to /var/log/ci/gc-3419998888.log.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Rerun on runner-build-14 completed: artifact uploaded, verifier computed=ffee0011 expected=ffee0011. Starting smoke.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Smoke PASSED. Promote completed.

Omar: Release note added: "Promote briefly blocked due to runner overlay filesystem filling up causing partial artifact upload; reran on a healthy runner and promoted. Investigating GC scheduling and adding disk-space preflight checks."

Janet: Good catch and quick recovery. Please include the GC schedule fix and the preflight free-space guard in the follow-up action items.
